test_title: PYST 13: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : ONJ :: VUQ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : ONJ :: VUQ : %

**Option 1) # = RIO, % = ASN**

**For # (RIO) to ONJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afc1679fc649629642e77d1cd5ebcdf3dd25f9ae7a79d6df9df8163ba5a298a2.png] 

The pattern derived from RIO to ONJ is: (-3, +5, -5).

**For VUQ to % (ASN)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad4a12ac308656ca4e05c765491fb15d35fe1862286cbacbc0f216be7ffa71c7.png] 

The pattern derived from VUQ to ASN is: (-21, -2, -3).

Since the pattern for RIO to ONJ (-3, +5, -5) is not the same as the pattern for VUQ to ASN (-21, -2, -3), Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = UIM, % = STN**

**For # (UIM) to ONJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b45b05177e40d865b22f6435cf53127df2286498f10f9c4fda12ed88fbecf39.png] 

The pattern derived from UIM to ONJ is: (-6, +5, -3).

**For VUQ to % (STN)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b74edeadd7391d3f125b71e73c823fdc612aecff476b3483fe80dca1dc87364e.png] 

The pattern derived from VUQ to STN is: (-3, -1, -3).

Since the pattern for UIM to ONJ (-6, +5, -3) is not the same as the pattern for VUQ to STN (-3, -1, -3), Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = RYM, % = PRN**

**For # (RYM) to ONJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85ea59b0f68e71c81c2f6d11881bb090015e8aaeff7355951db6399c649ef330.png] 

The pattern derived from RYM to ONJ is: (-3, -11, -3).

**For VUQ to % (PRN)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/def3aadb0e6eb120fc2d13882d27b911afc7ce3c091286e8b06a031602eaf66d.png] 

The pattern derived from VUQ to PRN is: (-6, -3, -3).

Since the pattern for RYM to ONJ (-3, -11, -3) is not the same as the pattern for VUQ to PRN (-6, -3, -3), Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = RQM, % = SRN**

**For # (RQM) to ONJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba5c6dbb9fb64dd62bfe2ee214b6e4884f19c09801a0dff883792083f4df93d9.png] 

The pattern derived from RQM to ONJ is: (-3, -3, -3).

**For VUQ to % (SRN)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de2e3f210568fac7c5baf64da3e22f7bc0d158f9c46d3d0a1c1ec3e43312b695.png] 

The pattern derived from VUQ to SRN is: (-3, -3, -3).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
